title: WeBuild – LEI (Legal Entity Identifier) Attestation – SD-JWT VC payload
description: Schema for the SD-JWT VC payload of a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) Attestation as defined in the LEI Attestation Rulebook (rb-lei, Chapter 5.1). This models the JSON claims set prior to SD-JWT disclosure/packing. The attestation provides a verifiable representation of a legal entity's LEI code (ISO 17442) together with its current registration status and next renewal date, as maintained by an accredited Local Operating Unit (LOU). It is a non-qualified Electronic Attestation of Attributes (EAA). No claim requires selective disclosure, as the included data is public.

vct.description: Verifiable Credential Type identifier. SHALL be 'eu.we-build.lei.1'.

iss.description: Issuer of the attestation, i.e. the issuing authority (LEI Issuer / LOU). Carries the rulebook's 'issuing_authority' metadata as the SD-JWT VC 'iss' claim (RFC 7519).

iat.description: Issuance date as a Unix timestamp.

exp.description: Expiry date as a Unix timestamp. Carries the rulebook's 'expiry_date' metadata.

attestation_legal_category.description: Legal category of the attestation. For the LEI attestation this is the non-qualified 'EAA'.

issuing_country.description: Alpha-2 country code (ISO 3166-1) of the country or territory of the provider of the attestation data.

lei.description: Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) code, in the format specified by ISO 17442 (a 20-character alphanumeric code, the last two characters being check digits).

lei_status.description: Status of the LEI record registration with the managing LOU.

lei_renewal_date.description: Next renewal date of the LEI record, given as a date and time including the timezone (ISO 8601).

status.description: Status object for revocation checking. Required when the technical validity period of the attestation exceeds 24 hours.

jwk.description: Public key bound to the holder wallet.
